answer.rationale: The incumbent will not meet the mandated 18% spend reduction and the low-cost vendor is the only quoted option that does. Verify the prior low-cost-vendor record before committing, because its historical evidence supports cost, onboarding, and invoice accuracy but does not yet establish delivery performance under the current 94%-utilization, no-buffer condition. Limit implementation to a guarded transition with explicit delivery and continuity protections rather than assuming prior onboarding success eliminates supply risk.
